method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading, reverse paraphrase, coding-edge-case review and exact formula/macro/token/reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Prime-power coding of finite natural-number sequences and primitive-recursive length, append, element, concatenation, bounds, iterated concatenation, tail and subsequence operations.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A finite sequence is coded by consecutive primes raised to each entry plus one; adding one distinguishes trailing zeros, and zero is chosen as the canonical empty code. Unique prime factorization makes the coding injective.
samples.checks: Every indexed prime, exponent shift, example sequence, empty-code value and uniqueness condition a_k≥1 is preserved. The official theorem title and sequence vocabulary are used.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Length finds the final consecutive prime divisor with R and bounded minimization. Append multiplies by the next prime power. Element finds the first exponent whose next power fails to divide, returning zero beyond the sequence length.
samples.checks: The two empty codes, zero-based indexing, p_i versus p_(i+1), exponent offsets a+1/a+2, case branches and strict search bounds are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Compact tuple notation iterates append. concat is obtained by primitive recursion through hconcat, which starts at s and appends entry (t)_n at each successor stage; infix concatenation abbreviates the result.
samples.checks: Tuple order and the hconcat recurrence are unchanged. OLCMP-009 calls the copied natural-number entries elements rather than the frozen source's inconsistent symbols.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For positive length k and entries at most x, the code is bounded by p_(k−1) to the k(x+1). At zero length the bound is one. This permits a bounded-search specification of concatenation by length and elementwise agreement.
samples.checks: The positive-length prime bound and nested bounded universal conditions remain exact. OLCMP-008 supplies the omitted zero-length value needed when both input lengths vanish.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Exercises request concatenation of a coded sequence of sequences, removal of the first element, and a primitive-recursive fixed-length subsequence beginning at a given index; the proposition's reference is preserved.
samples.checks: The empty-tail value, element ranges, subsequence arguments, label and cross-reference options are exact.

source_observations: MR-P147 directly attests क्रमिका, सांत क्रमिका and उपक्रमिका.
MR-P148 directly names अंकगणिताचे मूलभूत प्रमेय and states uniqueness of prime factors; MR-P149 independently supports अनन्य अवयवीकरण.
The operational compounds for numeric code, append, concatenation and sequence bound are fixed by the displayed formulas and remain expert-reviewable.
OLCMP-008 and OLCMP-009 record the zero-length bound completion and the natural-number element label correction.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The exact Marathi compounds for append, concatenation and sequence bound were not independently attested.
